text: Reverse Engineering Toolkit 是面向 DSH 的本地软件分析技能，通过注册 profile 全局的 reverse-engineering 技能，让 agent 按需读取分析步骤。它涵盖 Android APK/AAB、Java/JAR、原生二进制、.NET、Electron 包和固件，并可先探测本机工具，再按制品类型整理检查流程与证据记录，适合需要了解本地程序结构或提取清单、资源信息的场景。探测脚本面向 Windows PowerShell；不配置 API 密钥。

Reverse Engineering Toolkit adds an on-demand local analysis skill to DSH for Android, Java/JAR, native binaries, .NET, Electron, and firmware. It checks available local tools and guides artifact inspection and evidence notes. The probe targets Windows PowerShell; no API key is configured.
想先看看 APK 或 JAR 里有哪些结构和资源。
让 DSH 根据文件类型引导我分析本地程序。
How can I inspect a local .NET or native binary with tools already installed?
Reverse Engineering Toolkit 的功能「本地工具链探测」：随附脚本检查 PATH、常见安装目录和 Android SDK 中可用的分析工具，并输出工具路径与可获取的版本信息。
Reverse Engineering Toolkit 的功能「多格式分析指引」：按 APK、JAR、原生二进制、.NET、Electron 或固件类型提供检查步骤与结果记录格式，便于整理可追溯的本地分析发现。

text:
@local/dsh-reverse-skill README · What it does：- Adds a `skill` catalog entry that the agent loads on demand, then follows to
  classify an artifact, probe installed decompilers, work an authorized target,
  and report evidence-backed findings.
- Bundles `scripts/probe-tools.ps1` (32 tools across Android/Java/.NET/native/
  support, PATH + common install dirs + Android SDK, ~1.5 s, read-only).
- Enforces a blocking authorization gate and an explicit refusal list before any
  tool call, and degrades honestly when a decompiler is missing.

@local/dsh-reverse-skill README · Install (once)：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill.git C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

Then, from a DSH session with Full access or approval:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

The install is a **link**: keep that directory in place, or the plugin breaks.
To update later: `git pull` in that directory, then toggle the row off and on
(the `SKILL.md` body is re-read on activation).

@local/dsh-reverse-skill README · On / off：- `plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=reverse-skill enabled=false` — unregisters
  the skill; the next turn receives a replacement catalog without it.
- `enabled=true` — re-registers it (the SKILL.md body is re-read on activation,
  so content edits take effect after a toggle, without restarting DSH).
- `action=remove_bundle target=@local/dsh-reverse-skill` — uninstalls completely.

@local/dsh-reverse-skill README · Safety：The skill refuses DRM/licence/anti-cheat bypass, credential theft, unauthorized
targets, live-service interaction, and redistribution of decompiled material. It
never executes a target on the host; dynamic analysis is limited to a disposable
device/VM the user authorizes. Decompiling a client never reveals server-side
logic — the skill states that limit instead of overselling.
